title: Pricing Memorandum on the Charge Booked for an Agreed Change of Specification
content:
# Pricing Memorandum on the Charge Booked for an Agreed Change of Specification

The charge booked to a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions for a change agreed to the specification is the value of the work the customer has committed to, together with the programme's administration fee for the change, together with the studio's charge for re-opening the commission at the bench, together with the studio's premium for the metal the piece is to be made in, together with the studio's charge for the bench days the change gives back, and the five are added together before any settlement against an upgrade credit is taken.

## The five charges

**1. The value of the work the customer has committed to.** It is read from the confirmation of the change standing on the studio's request record, taken at the latest date such a confirmation is to take effect from.

**2. The administration fee.** The administration fee is the programme's fee for a change to the specification as the programme sets it: that fee taken at 1 times itself.

**3. Re-opening the commission at the bench.** Nothing is charged for re-opening the commission at the bench: it is charged at 0 per cent of the value of the work the customer has committed to.

**4. The premium for the metal.** Nothing is added for the metal the piece is to be made in: the premium is 0 per cent of that same value.

**5. The bench days the change gives back.** The bench days the change gives back are counted from the date production began to the day the change is priced, and are never fewer than none. They are charged at the studio's daily rate for a commission not yet settled at the bench, USD 8.00 for each such day.

## Settlement against an upgrade credit

Nothing of the figure reached is settled against an upgrade credit: the share settled against it is 0 per cent of the figure reached.

## Rounding

Each of the five charges that make up the figure reached is rounded half up to two decimal places as it is worked out, and the figure booked is the figure reached less the share settled against an upgrade credit, rounded half up to two decimal places once that share has been taken off.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

A Design Studio Custom Setting commission, whose programme's fee for a change to the specification is USD 150.00. The confirmation standing on the studio's request record, at the latest date such a confirmation is to take effect from, carries USD 900.00. Production began on the 1st of a month and the change is priced on the 15th.

| Charge | Worked |
|---|---|
| The value of the work committed to | USD 900.00 |
| The administration fee | USD 150.00 taken at 1 times itself, USD 150.00 |
| Re-opening at the bench | 0 per cent of USD 900.00, USD 0.00 |
| The premium for the metal | 0 per cent of USD 900.00, USD 0.00 |
| The bench days | 14 days at USD 8.00 each, USD 112.00 |
| The five added together | USD 1162.00 |
| Less the share settled against an upgrade credit | 0 per cent of USD 1162.00, USD 0.00 |
| The figure booked, rounded half up to two decimal places | USD 1162.00 |
